name: grok-bots
title: Grok Bots
description: Send prompts to your Grok Bot teammates: pick a Bot, type a request, and send it in the Grok Bot app or through a routine webhook.
author: stanleybogode

commands.name: chat-with-bot
commands.title: Chat with Grok Bot
commands.description: Pick one of your Grok Bots and send it a prompt.

preferences.name: autoSend
preferences.title: Delivery
preferences.label: Send automatically (press Return in Grok Bot)
preferences.description: Grok Bot's prompt links only fill in the message box. When this is on, Raycast waits until your prompt is in the box and presses Return for you. Needs Raycast to be allowed in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.

preferences.name: useWebhooks
preferences.title: Webhooks
preferences.label: Send through a bot's routine webhook when one is set
preferences.description: Bots with a webhook set up in this extension get the prompt in the background, without opening Grok Bot.

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.title: Hidden Bots
preferences.label: Include bots hidden from the sidebar
preferences.description: List Bots you've hidden from Grok Bot's sidebar. They stay active and can still get prompts.

preferences.name: dataDir
preferences.title: Grok Bot Data Folder
preferences.description: Only needed if Grok Bot stores its data somewhere other than ~/Library/Application Support/Grok Bot.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
